title: The Token 8 Ball
tagline: The Token 8 Ball frame recommends tokens from its list and let's you buy them easily!
description: This project is a simple frame that has a list of tokens and displays them (in a random order in the future) to you. It also has a redirection link to where you can buy them. It currently redirects users to Uniswap, but in the future users will be able to buy tokens directly within the Frame.
how_its_made: This projects uses the frog.fm boilerplate. We spent most of the time this weekend learning how Frames work. We've also reviewed onchainkit(onchainkit.xyz), and framesjs (framesjs.org) but frog had simple tutorials that we could follow so we settled with frog. We've used the Next.js boilerplate of frog and deployed it through Vercel.
